title: CapsuleRunReceipt
description: What actually happened when a capsule ran. Persisted before the output envelope is built, so a resume after a crash finds the receipt and does not repeat the work. Separates RUNTIME outcome from VALIDATION outcome on purpose: a timed-out inspector is a runtime failure, not a failing check, and collapsing the two is how a broken runner starts reading as a broken artifact.

refusal_code.description: Machine-readable reason when status is REFUSED. 'invalid' is not a reason a person can act on, so every refusal path has its own code.

tokens_spent.description: Output tokens attributable to this invocation. Zero for deterministic adapters, and recorded rather than assumed.

adapter.description: Which adapter served the invocation, e.g. 'scripted' or 'structured-worker'.
